title: Tallstrider
wikitext:
These ostrich-like [[beast]]s are native to [[Kalimdor]]. 
*Plainstriders are found in the [[Barrens]] and [[Mulgore]]
*Foreststriders can be found in [[Darkshore]].

*The [[Gnome]]s modelled their [[Mechano-strider]] [[mount]]s after striders.
